Scherzo Cloud CLI v0.1.1

## Breaking changes

- Replace `--server` with `--gateway-url`; update scripts to use the new flag.

## Added

- Add `scherzo-cloud account signup` for first-time account creation.
- Add account export.

## Changed

- Change run summaries to include queued work.

## Fixed

- Fix login retries.
- Fix run monitoring occasionally stopping before completion.
